decisions.statement: A path the index files no page at is refused.
A page and every file that page keeps beside the page go together.
A file beside the page goes whether or not git tracks that file.
Which files sit beside a page is read from the index rather than from the folder.
A file the page claims and the tree has no body at is left alone.
The page's entry in the parent's `parts` is dropped before any file goes.
A file importing a second file going in the same act goes before that file.
The files beside the page go before the page's own file.
A file beside the page under a TypeScript name goes by `remove-code-file`.
Every other file beside the page goes by `remove-file`.
The page's own file goes by `remove-code-file`.
A refusal from any change reached here refuses the whole removal.
Every index question here is asked of the world the caller hands in.
Containment is a relation named in the parent's `parts`.
The module taking a value away is called for the parent's `parts` rather than reached.
A parent naming the page bare rather than qualified is dropped just the same.
Which files in the act import which is answered by the graph.
The order those files go in is worked out here rather than in the graph.

definition: one page taken away with every file that page keeps beside the page
